title: Existence of a direct-image Roos object
statement: For the actual additive system direct image and a normalized reduction of an arbitrary derived object, there exist a product of the finite direct-image terms, a SfIntegralDirectImage Roos triangle, and an isomorphism from the total derived coefficient limit to its Roos object.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21; Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks Tag 0941.

proof.text: Apply the generic strict-tower construction (UniverseProof.evaluationData and CoreWork.natural_roos in RingedStrictTowerHomotopyLimitOfUniverses) to the specified canonical coefficientConstantTowerLimit. Its unit is the canonical rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ, invertible on K-injective complexes. Grothendieck module sheaves and the derived product construction supply all countable products. This gives the actual total-limit vertex and a Milnor triangle for the simultaneous evaluated tower V(Z).

source.place: Tags 0940 and 0941, derived limits and the strict-tower Milnor triangle; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10 for the coefficient tower.

proof.text: Take a complex T representing Z, the exact completed-coefficient restriction of the actual system direct image. The restricted-tower comparison supplies a natural isomorphism T.asFunctor followed by localization to the finite direct-image tower. Compose with the evaluation factorization and the chosen representing isomorphism to identify the whole tower V(Z) with that tower.

Map the component isomorphisms through the product. Naturality at adjacent arrows makes this product isomorphism intertwine the two one-minus-shift endomorphisms. Transport the distinguished triangle with identity on its first vertex and this product isomorphism on both other vertices. The resulting projection is p followed by the product isomorphism, and its boundary is the inverse product isomorphism followed by delta. This explicitly constructs SfIntegralDirectImage with its required recorded transition; its vertex is definitionally the coefficientSequenceLimit of N, so the final comparison is identity.

lean.statement:
theorem systemDirectImage_roosExistence
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [(integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).Additive]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (coefficientSequenceModules l E X)]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) :
    let N := (integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
      (S.reduction.obj K)
    ∃ hprod : HasProduct (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K),
      ∃ L : @SfIntegralDirectImage l _ E _ _ _ X Y f K hprod,
        ∃ e : ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y).obj N ≅ L.obj), True
